newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BANK SHARES OUTPACE OTHERS ON SURGING BUDAPEST MKT.
newsitem.headline: BANK SHARES OUTPACE OTHERS ON SURGING BUDAPEST MKT.

text.p: Hungarian bank shares powered ahead to new record highs on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Thursday and outpaced most other surging stocks benefiting from a bullish note on the market.
"So far they have not risen at the same pace as other stocks and now they want to catch up with them," one trader said.
Another trader also said he did not see any immediate reason behind the rise but said their rally stemmed from positive market sentiment.
OTP shares opened at 3,500 forints, above Wednesday's close of 3,450 and rallied to a new record of 3,800. At 1132 GMT it traded at 3,800.
Inter-Europa Bank surged to a new high of 44,500 forints from its opening level of 41,000 forints and Wednesday's close of 40,600.
